content.title: All About The Bachelorette Taylor Frankie Paul's 3 Kids & Their Dads
content.text: Skip to main content Skip to header navigation optional screen reader All About The Bachelorette Taylor Frankie Paul’s 3 Kids & Their Dads March 19, 2026 at 4:29pm EDT Taylor Frankie Paul Gilbert Flores/Penske Media via Getty Images Taylor Frankie Paul is focusing on her kids after her season of The Bachelorette was canceled. After a video emerged showing Paul throwing chairs at ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen during a 2023 argument, ABC pulled the plug on Paul’s season. Paul is a mom of three children: daughter Indy, born in 2017, and son Ocean, born in 2020, whom she shares with ex-husband Tate Paul, and son Ever, born in 2024, with on-again, off-again boyfriend Mortensen. Paul separated from her ex-husband in May 2022 amid her now-infamous “soft swinging” scandal and started dating Mortensen two months later. In 2023, The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives was arrested for a reported domestic violence incident, in which she allegedly threw “heavy metal chairs” at Mortensen that hit her daughter, who was sitting next to him. Paul was charged with assault, criminal mischief, and commission of domestic violence in the presence of a child. She pleaded guilty to aggravated assault in Aug. 2023 and the other four charges were dismissed, per the New York Post. Paul and Mortensen reconciled and continued to date on and off until she started filming The Bachelorette in October 2025. Related story Who Taylor Frankie Paul Got Engaged To On Her Canceled Season Of The Bachelorette On March 16, People reported that filming for Season 5 of SLOMW was put on hold due to an alleged open domestic assault investigation into Paul and Mortensen. Paul addressed the incident in a March 17 premiere of The Bachelorette in New York City. “There’s more to the context to everything and it’s unfortunate,” Paul told Us Weekly. “It’s been hard. And it sucks to be in this position. And the mother that I am, that is something I will always stand my ground on.” “I believe that I am a good mother and I have always treated my kids very well,” she continued. “So the headlines that are out right now are very hard to see because that’s not the truth of it. I have always treated my children with respect and I’ve never touched them. So it’s been really hard.” RELATED: Here’s How Much Taylor Frankie Paul Is Allegedly Getting Paid for The Bachelorette Taylor Frankie Paul’s Kids Indy, 8 Paul’s firstborn daughter, Indy, was born on Aug. 31, 2017. “Indy May Paul officially arrived Aug 31st weighing 6lbs 9oz,” she announced on Instagram a day later. “She is perfection and we are so obsessed with our baby girl. 💗 we are so blessed.” She’s posted about her daughter often throughout the years, including a Sept. 2025 TikTok of her helping Indy get dressed in a country-western outfit, where she talked about how she’ll explain about her past behaviors and scandals to her kids when they get older. “Your kids will see this one day,” she wrote on Instagram, quoting hateful comments she’s received in the past. Paul agreed, writing, “Facts and I’ll get to explain the consequences certain decisions come with. I won’t have my kids afraid to come to me with mistakes, those are when they [need] us most.” In the caption, Paul added, “Not proud of my mistakes, however I will be able to empathize with a lot, relate, be a safe place so they feel comfortable seeking help because they know mom has made mistakes, maybe she’ll understand.” In a March 11 interview with Us Weekly, Paul shared her daughter’s adorable reaction to her mom going on The Bachelorette. “It was the cutest thing,” Paul told the outlet. “I shared little notes that my daughter wrote and she was like, ‘I am hoping you find your person, your man, your husband.’ She was very, very aware and cute.” RELATED: Why the Kids of #MomTok Rarely Appear in The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives (Exclusive) Ocean, 5 Paul’s first son, Ocean, was born on June 18, 2020. She shared a TikTok video announcing his birth a few days later, writing, “Ocean Paul arrived 4 days ago. 6 lbs 15 oz with lots of hair and a sweet soul.” On his first birthday, she shared sweet pictures of Ocean, writing, “I refuse to believe it’s been a year with my Ocean, but the calendar says otherwise🥺 Happy birthday to my sweet boy, I LOVE YOU so much. Time flies gotta cherish these young years.” Paul shares custody of Ocean and Indy with her ex-husband, who she seems to be on good terms with. In a March 12 interview with Us Weekly, Paul revealed that she and Tate have “always been really good friends and [have a] very healthy co-parenting relationship.” “A man that loves their mother of their children is just, like, a good man, right? And so he’s always done that,” she added. RELATED: Who Is Taylor Frankie Paul’s Ex-Husband? All About Tate Paul’s Life After Their ‘Swinging’ Scandal Ever, 2 Paul and Mortensen’s son Ever was born on March 19, 2024. She announced his birth in a March 20, 2024 Instagram post. “Meet Ever Mortensen our angel sent from heaven🕊️” she captioned a photo of her holding her newborn in the hospital room. In another post, Paul shared more details. “Ever True was born March 19th, 6lbs 15oz a week early and we’ve had the best two weeks with him,” she wrote. “We all love you so much, thank you for blending our family 🤍” She often posts sweet videos and pictures of Ever, including one in June 2025 of the toddler grabbing his mom’s face and kissing her. “I saw someone say ‘Maybe god gives the clingiest babies to the moms who never felt like anyone’s first choice” According to TMZ, Paul and Mortensen are sharing custody of son, Ever, through a third party and have not seen or spoken to each other in three weeks as the Utah Division of Child and Family Services investigates the alleged open domestic assault allegations.
